entityStylePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game battle sprite for Tomageddon. Reference image is STYLE reference ONLY: cute chibi manga, clean dark outlines, big readable expressive eyes, polished warm cel shading, vivid colors. Create exactly ONE isolated creature full body centered, square canvas, true transparent background. Slightly elevated three-quarter FRONT view facing slightly RIGHT, suitable for top-down arena game. Entire silhouette including feet antennae wings within center 80% of canvas, ground contact around y=87%, centered x=50%. No floor, pedestal, cast ground shadow, environment, glow background, text, labels, border, reference panels. Thick readable silhouette, restrained texture readable at 35-110px. Light upper left. Cute comical mischievous food/insect monster, never realistic disgusting or gory. Not a sheet, not multiple poses.
